# OCEAN — full detail (English)

> OCEAN (legal name: Ocean Industries; OCEAN is a registered trademark) is an AI software and engineering studio. It designs and builds custom AI software, AI agents for WhatsApp, phone calls and the web, process automation and high-performance websites. It works with companies in the United States (Florida: Miami and Fort Lauderdale; Dallas–Fort Worth) and Colombia (Cali and Bogotá), starting with construction and home services. It works in Spanish, English and Portuguese. Motto: "From the deepest to the highest."

The site (https://www.oceanindustries.com.co/, also in English at /en and Portuguese at /pt) is one continuous film that follows the scroll: from orbit, down below the sea, to a snowy summit. The idea: what makes a business grow is mostly unseen (agents, data, automation, software) and it holds up what customers do see (the brand, the website, the sale). The landscapes are AI-generated illustrations; names and figures in the sample scenes (such as the "Valeria" chat) are examples, not real clients.

## Services (in order of focus)

### 1. Custom AI software
- Problem it solves: the team copies and pastes data between systems all day.
- What OCEAN builds: custom dashboards and software with AI, connected to the client's database, CRM and spreadsheets. "The end of endless Excel."
- Page: https://www.oceanindustries.com.co/en#software

### 2. AI agents for WhatsApp, phone and web
- Problem it solves: sales are lost outside business hours.
- What OCEAN builds: agents set up on the business's current number. They reply in seconds, day and night (24/7), book into the calendar, log every conversation for review and hand the conversation to a person when they don't know the answer.
- Measured figure: 11-second average reply, measured on OCEAN's own WhatsApp line.
- Page: https://www.oceanindustries.com.co/en#omnicanal

### 3. Process automation
- Problem it solves: the business's tools don't talk to each other.
- What OCEAN builds: CRM, payments, WhatsApp, calendar and AI connected into one system that runs itself.
- Page: https://www.oceanindustries.com.co/en#automatizacion

### 4. High-performance websites and stores
- Problem it solves: a slow site that doesn't convert on mobile.
- What OCEAN builds: sites and stores that load instantly on a phone, with catalog, payments and SEO. A clickable prototype in 48 hours; if the client likes it, it launches.
- Page: https://www.oceanindustries.com.co/en#web

### 5. Social content (UGC) and Meta ads
- Vertical content for TikTok, Reels and Facebook, made to hold attention in the first seconds and bring the conversation to WhatsApp.
- Meta Ads campaigns built for WhatsApp conversations with qualified leads, not clicks.
- Pages: https://www.oceanindustries.com.co/en#ugc and https://www.oceanindustries.com.co/en#performance

## Process
1. First contact on WhatsApp (+57 313 872 1665) or a free, no-commitment 45-minute Google Meet call booked on Cal.com. OCEAN looks at how the business handles customers today, finds where sales slip away and says what it would automate first.
2. The client describes the moment where their customer gets stuck; OCEAN builds a first prototype in 24 to 48 hours.
3. If it convinces, it goes to production. Agents run 24/7 and hand off to a person when needed.
4. Payments can be made online through Wompi (card, PSE, Nequi or Bancolombia), charged in Colombian pesos; USD amounts are converted at the day's rate. Card details go straight to Wompi and never pass through OCEAN.

## Published work
- Outstanding Garage Doors (Miami, Florida; local service business in South Florida): its phone line and WhatsApp connected to AI agents that answer and hand off to a person. Voice agent live and English site published; WhatsApp being tuned. https://www.outstandinggaragedoors.com/
- Naidikó (Colombian Pacific; a brand of naidí, the Pacific's açaí): its own website with catalog, forms and WhatsApp orders; catalog, wholesale and investment live. https://www.naidiko.co/
- Álvaro Arroyo (Colombia; public figure): a 20-page authority site built for search engines, published with its 20 pages indexed. https://www.alvaroarroyo.com/
